numbers.value: 24/24 random chains (n = 4, 2, 0.5, -1), rel < 1e-10 plus float cancellation allowance

numbers.name: sign_of_c_minus_1
numbers.value: positive for n = 4, 2; negative for n = 0.5, -1 (all sampled chains)

note: Illustrative case: n = 4, T0 = 5778, T_N = 2.725, G0 = 1, G_N = (T0/T_N)^3, entropy flux s1 = 0.1 G0 T0^3, split J_1 = J_0/2; below G_mid ~ 3 the middle contact cannot carry the heat. The effect is small unless a contact works near its limit. Reversible stages, power-law contacts of one exponent n, no dilution of sunlight, dividers do not warm up. Nearest theory: endoreversible engines with radiative contacts (De Vos 1985) and the dependence of finite-time results on the heat-transfer law. Not UET-distinct. AI derivation following the author's chain question (2026-11-21).
